Tyvriv New Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine

Not demolished. Tyvriv's Jews rebelled against Russian tax policy in 1845, beating a tax collector to death before the Russian army quelled the revolt — a striking episode of internal resistance recorded in this collection. Two separate Einsatzkommando units, five and six of Einsatzgruppe C, carried out consecutive massacres of the town's Jews in 1941: about 30 men shortly after the occupation began, and some 400 more in November. This is the newer of Tyvriv's two Jewish cemeteries, holding about 100 headstones from the first half of the 20th century.
